pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"Consult: the check-in code at the door. Install and removal days: that day's code at the door, or the lockbox and a start photo for a vacant home. Studio: the code at the desk. Video: the code read out at the start.","at_the_visit":"The stager walks the rooms, measures the main ones, takes before photos with the owner's OK and notes what the owner wants kept out. A written proposal with a price follows the same day or the next business day, good for 14 days.","changes":"Changes after signing are change orders: a new price and a new yes, signed before the added work","outside_checks":"None by the stager. Repairs, painting and cleaning belong to the pros the owner hires.","done":"The walk-through (with the owner, the agent, or by photo): every room checked against the plan, with any fix list noted, then DONE on install day. pluginText.pf.money: {"visit":"The example's $89 staging consult counts toward the project price if Alex signs, and is billed alone only if no agreement follows. The owner may have the saved card charged at DONE instead of texting the bill. Any cap on money paid before the work comes from the state's form.","final":"The rest after the install, with any change orders, on the bill Rosie texts (or the business's own way)","change_orders":"Added to the final bill, as signed","rental":"Furniture and decor are rented for the term and included in the price; nothing is sold. A rental extension is added only with the owner's yes in their own chat and billed after the new removal day.","someone_else_pays":"A listing agent may pay: what is due at booking is paid on the page by the person booking; the payer gets a pay link only for the rest and approves nothing; the owner signs the agreement","big_bills":"Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. pluginText.pf.messages: {"never_in_texts":["Lockbox, key or door codes","The listing price and the budget","Proposals, agreements and change orders (secure page only, with a copy by email)"],"photos":"Room photos only on the secure page, and shown to others only with the owner's OK; never photos of papers, IDs or people","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"roles":"Lead stagers (Victor, Dev) for consults, install and removal days; staging advisors (Camille, Jonas) at the studio","licenses":"No person license unless the state's form asks. Stagers work under the business.","who_oks":"Sam OKs proposals and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins","stand_in":"Another stager may take a consult if Alex agrees; a project keeps its lead stager unless Sam moves it","assistants":"A helper may carry and place furniture with a lead stager; never signs for the business or handles the owner's valuables"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"agreement":"A written agreement for project work, signed by the owner and the business before any deposit: the rooms, the furniture and decor plan, the install day, the term and removal day, the extension rate, the damage terms, the project price and how it is paid, and the change-order rule","damage":"Damage to rented pieces or to the home is handled by the agreement; Sam decides, and the owner's side is told in writing","items_kept_out":"Valuables, papers, medicines, firearms and personal photos are put away by the owner before install day; the crew never handles them","agreement_parts":"Any parts the state's form lists, like a registration number or the cancel notice for an agreement that began at the home","cancel_window":"Where the rules give a cancel window for a sale made at the home, nothing is delivered until it ends","inventory":"Staging furniture and decor stay the business's own property; nothing is sold","show":"A registration number on the listing, the proposal and the agreement, where the state's rules require it","warranty":"No guarantee of a sale. A free touch-up visit for a piece placed wrongly within 14 days (the owner's setting)","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"delivery_late":"A piece is late: the install day moves, or the room is staged in two parts; the photo date is checked, with no fee","photo_date_moves":"The listing photographer moves the date: the install day moves with it, with no fee","sells_early":"The home sells early: removal day moves earlier; the agreement says what is kept for unused days","damaged_piece":"A piece is damaged or dented: it goes on the fix list and is swapped from van stock, or the damage terms apply","no_access":"The lockbox or key does not work and nobody answers in 15 minutes: the crew leaves; Sam decides about a fee","extension":"A month more is added only with the owner's yes and billed after the new removal day","walk_through_dispute":"Goes to Sam; the last bill waits","renter":"A rented home needs the landlord's OK for any fixed hooks or wall hangings","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
